The next necessary state is therefore a real typed evaluator—not regex substitution—with a lexer/parser, scoped variables and closures, pipeline built-ins, and a renderer that preserves those distinctions. I’m implementing that core now, then the differential failures will drive only evidence-based compatibility fixes.
